Minutes of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City and County of San Francisco, November 1, 1928
sources.label: Board of Park Commissioners minutes, San Francisco Public Library (Internet Archive)

historical_record.description: The Board of Park Commissioners received the Supervisors' resolution setting aside as parkland a 200-foot square on the summit of Mount Olympus, near Ashbury and 16th Streets, centered on the monument standing there, land Adolph Sutro had given the city by deed of November 22, 1887.
